title: Training Note: Guest Payments, the Deductible and the HostCover Level on Valuables Claims
content:
**Host Damage Protection (HostCover) valuables claims.** The valuables recovery-sharing method follows the plan level and decides how the guest payments recorded on the claim, net of reversals, are shared between Roamhaven and the host.

| HostCover level | What is subtracted from the adjusted valuables loss |
|---|---|
| HostCover Premier, HostCover Elite, HostCover Estate | only the larger of the guest payments and the deductible: the guest payments first restore the deductible the valuables claim bears |
| HostCover Standard, HostCover Plus | the deductible, together with the guest payments multiplied by the adjusted valuables loss less the deductible (never below 0.00) and divided by the adjusted valuables loss: the guest payments are shared in proportion to the parts of the loss each side bears |
| any other level (HostCover Essential) | the guest payments and the deductible, both |

**What is the adjusted valuables loss?** The valuables loss being settled, before guest payments and the deductible come off it.

**What counts as guest payments?** Every guest payment recorded on the valuables claim, less any of those payments reversed by the guest's card issuer.

**Which deductible?** The deductible the valuables claim bears.

**On a HostCover Premier plan, an adjusted valuables loss of 4000.00, guest payments of 300.00 and a deductible of 100.00: what is left?** 3700.00. The larger of 300.00 and 100.00, that is 300.00, is subtracted. (Hypothetical figures.)

**The same figures on a HostCover Plus plan?** 100.00 plus 300.00 multiplied by 3900.00 and divided by 4000.00 (292.50) is subtracted, 392.50 in all, leaving 3607.50.

**And on HostCover Essential?** 300.00 plus 100.00, that is 400.00, is subtracted, leaving 3600.00.
